name: Snowflake Analytics Sync
description: After warehouse refresh, pull prediction scores (LTV, churn risk, upsell) → update customer records.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  customer_id,
  lifetime_value_prediction,
  churn_risk_score,
  upsell_likelihood_score,
  updated_at
FROM PREDICTIONS
WHERE updated_at >= DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
